messages.content: Rainy Sunday. Takeshi wants to take Rin fishing; Rin is mid-raid.

Rain or shine, Sunday's for fishing. Rin, hooks are baited, thermos is yours. You said five minutes, we both know how that goes.

Kai, back me up here. A raid can wait; the trout won't.

raid's on pull three. trout have waited their whole lives, they can wait one more.

five minutes means twenty, i know, i know. tell him the worms keep.

Worms keep, trout don't, and my patience runs on a tighter timetable than yours. Pull three then we roll.

You get twenty, same as always. I'll bait both hooks while you finish, spoilsport.

fine. twenty and not a second more, i'm holding you to my own terrible math for once.

we wipe after this and i'm blaming you both for the distraction, eaters of blame.
The rain suddenly stops and the sun comes out.

Sun's out. Told you the weatherman doesn't know his caboose from his coal car.

Time it right, we'll have the whole dock to ourselves. Twenty minutes, Rin. I'm counting in train time, which means exact.

sun showing up the second i committed. classic. the dock's gonna be all mud and no people, which honestly is the only version of fishing i respect.

fifteen now, old man. my raid's almost done and i don't waste daylight on principle.

Fifteen it is. Worms loaded, rods in the truck, engine's already warm.

You've got the thermos duty, remember. Coffee in, no sugar, or I start calling you a soft-shell.

Sun after a rain means trout go stupid-hungry. Best kind of stupid. Right on schedule.

no sugar, i remember. i've only messed that up twice and i heard about it for a year.

last pull. then i'm in the truck before he can honk.

I don't honk. Horns are for emergencies and bad drivers.

Truck leaves in ten. Wait, you're in IT, so ten means... right now.

he's been waiting years for a crowd that would laugh at that one. i'm not giving it to him.

logging off. my guild is going to kill me and honestly they'd be right.
